name: websearch-plus
description: Cuts built-in WebSearch usage cost by bundling three remote-hosted web-search MCP servers with free plans (Exa, Tavily, You.com; server names prefixed wsplus-, API keys from MCP_* env vars) and injecting a SessionStart instruction that makes Claude use them first, one at a time until its rate limit or quota is hit, with the built-in WebSearch as the final fallback.
